info.title: PlatformClaw AI usage report API
info.description: Implemented on the standard Control Plane Web listener; deploy a build containing this API. No application token, API key, or browser login. Network edge permits approved intranet clients. Initial reporting scope: owned personal agents. Full semantic contract: docs/platformclaw/ai-usage-report-api.md. Display ai_service=PlatformClaw; identify underlying providers and models separately.

servers.description: Placeholder; replace with deployed intranet origin.
Placeholder for direct intranet access on the default existing Runtime Compose Web port. Network access is operator-controlled.

get.summary: Read monthly employee AI usage with optional model grouping
get.description: Optional filters enable personal, multi-person, department, provider and model reporting. No dates defaults to this month in Asia/Seoul. Choose one of month, start_month/end_month pair, or period. Accept 1 to 12 inclusive months; reject future months, blank filters, unknown/repeated parameters, and request bodies. Normalize and verify all requested accounts; unknown accounts return 404. Apply filters before grouping, sorting and optional top-result limit. No report offset pagination. Totals describe the full filtered result before limit; returned_tokens describes returned rows. Never replace a full corporate month with filtered, partial, or truncated data. CSV requires complete retained-source data. Filtered views must be stored separately, keyed by normalized meta.filters in addition to source, grouping and row key; they must never overwrite the canonical unfiltered corporate dataset.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: One calendar month. Conflicts with period or either range parameter.

parameters.name: start_month
parameters.description: Inclusive first month. Requires end_month and conflicts with month/period.

parameters.name: end_month
parameters.description: Inclusive last month. Requires start_month; no future months; range at most 12 months.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Relative period resolved at request start in Asia/Seoul. Default this_month only when no date selector is supplied. Last 3 months includes current month.

parameters.name: knox_id
parameters.description: One account or at most 100 submitted comma-separated entries. Trim, lowercase and deduplicate; reject empty entries. OR inside list; AND with other filters. All accounts must exist.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: Exact current department; URL-encode spaces. Unknown values yield empty results.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Filter before aggregation, including service grouping. Unknown values yield empty results.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Filter before aggregation. Unknown values yield empty results.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: User/month/application totals or model detail. Do not add both views together.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Null last; ties use ascending month/account/application/provider/model, also null last.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Direction for the primary sort field.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional top-result cap; omit for full output. meta.truncated indicates omitted matches. No report offset pagination.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: CSV: UTF-8 BOM, CRLF, fixed eight-column header, formula-safe text, null as empty cells. Partial CSV returns 503 JSON.

200.description: JSON report, including explicitly marked partial or limited output, or a complete retained-source CSV download. Historical coverage remains unverified.

Content-Disposition.description: Required for CSV: attachment filename ai-usage-<start>_<end>-<grouping>.csv.

X-Report-Data-Status.description: Required for CSV; partial reports return 503 JSON.

X-Report-Truncated.description: Required for CSV; true for an explicitly limited ranking.

X-Report-Total-Rows.description: Required for CSV; matching rows before limit.

X-Report-Total-Tokens.description: Required for CSV; full filtered total, or unknown.

personal.summary: One verified account, no usage filters

ranking.summary: Top one model bucket; full and returned totals differ

400.description: Correct conflicting/incomplete dates, future months, invalid filters, unknown/repeated parameters, or request bodies.

error.message: Correct missing, invalid, unknown, repeated, future, or oversized month-range parameters; remove request bodies.

403.description: Check the approved network route. A firewall or proxy may instead return non-JSON or deny the connection.

error.message: Check the approved network route. A firewall or proxy may instead return non-JSON or deny the connection.

413.description: More than 100000 filtered rows without explicit limit. Retry by month, team, or selected accounts; an explicit limit produces a marked ranking.

error.message: More than 100000 rows. Retry a smaller month range; never silently truncate.

503.description: No reliable selected-scope snapshot, directory unavailable, or requested CSV would hide partial source data. Preserve accepted reports and retry after Retry-After.

error.message: No reliable report snapshot. Retry after Retry-After seconds; preserve the last accepted report.

500.description: Preserve the last accepted report and contact the operator.

error.message: Preserve the last accepted report and contact the operator.

404.description: At least one explicitly requested account is unknown or lacks a verified corporate login. Reject the whole request, not a partial account selection.

error.message: One or more requested accounts were not found

get.summary: Find registered people by corporate account or display name
get.description: Intranet directory helper without application authentication. Only verified corporate accounts; includes people without usage. Combine filters with AND. Sort by account ascending before live offset pagination. Unknown/repeated query parameters and request bodies return 400. Directory failure returns 503, not a fabricated empty list. No chat, email, employee-number or credential fields.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Trim and normalize Unicode NFC; case-insensitive substring search over account and display name. Omit to list all; blank is invalid.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Skip this many matches; beyond last row returns an empty list.

200.description: Matching directory page, including an empty result.

400.description: Correct conflicting/incomplete dates, future months, invalid filters, unknown/repeated parameters, or request bodies.

error.message: Correct missing, invalid, unknown, repeated, future, or oversized month-range parameters; remove request bodies.

403.description: Check the approved network route. A firewall or proxy may instead return non-JSON or deny the connection.

error.message: Check the approved network route. A firewall or proxy may instead return non-JSON or deny the connection.

503.description: Directory unavailable. Retry after Retry-After seconds; do not replace the cached directory with an empty list.

error.message: No reliable report snapshot. Retry after Retry-After seconds; preserve the last accepted report.

500.description: Preserve the last accepted report and contact the operator.

error.message: Preserve the last accepted report and contact the operator.

team.description: Verified employee department at report time, not event-time department.

knox_id.description: Verified corporate login account in lowercase. Employee-number fallback is prohibited.

ai_service.description: Application identity, separate from its model provider.

call_count.description: Persisted model records with usage data, not all HTTP attempts, prompts, or tool calls.

token_usage.description: Recorded provider total or normalized input + output + cache-read + cache-write. Null if any counted record has unknown token coverage.

provider.description: Recorded provider ID; null for service grouping or an unknown provider.

model.description: Recorded model ID; null for service grouping or an unknown model.

fetched_at.description: Report assembly time in Unix seconds, possibly fractional. Not a source completeness watermark.

active_row_count.description: Rows where call_count > 0 or known token_usage > 0.

team_size.description: Registered users matching account/department filters, including disabled users, before usage/provider/model filters. Null if roster unavailable; not corporate headcount.

active_user_count.description: Distinct active accounts in the full filtered result before limit.

months.description: All requested calendar months, ascending, including empty months.

total_tokens.description: Sum of full filtered token usage before limit, null if any contributing row is unknown. Zero for verified empty results.

group_by.description: Grouping used for this response. Never add both grouping views together.

scope.description: Owned personal agents only; excludes shared agents and independent AI programs.

call_count_basis.description: Count persisted model usage records, not provider HTTP attempts.

token_usage_basis.description: Provider total when recorded, otherwise normalized nonduplicated input/output/cache components. Without a total, both input and output must be recorded; absent cache buckets follow normalized zero defaults. Missing input or output makes the total unknown.

coverage.description: Retained transcript records, not guaranteed historical billing coverage.

data_status.description: Completeness of retained-source reads. Complete does not prove full historical coverage. Unknown tokens, unattributed personal usage, stale caches, or incomplete reads require partial.

warnings.description: Always includes HISTORICAL_COVERAGE_UNVERIFIED. Other codes: DIRECTORY_SIZE_UNAVAILABLE, UNKNOWN_TEAM, UNKNOWN_MODEL, UNKNOWN_TOKEN_USAGE, UNATTRIBUTED_PERSONAL_USAGE, SOURCE_READ_INCOMPLETE, USAGE_CACHE_STALE. Future additive codes allowed.

returned_tokens.description: Sum of returned rows only; null if any returned token usage is unknown.

total_call_count.description: Call total across all filtered rows before limit.

truncated.description: True only if explicit limit omitted matching rows.

limit.description: Explicit top-result limit or null for full output.

UsageReport.description: One filtered report or explicitly limited ranking. Preserve unknown model buckets. No offset pagination. Reject implicit oversized exports with 413. Consumers tolerate additive fields.

message.description: Safe actionable message without chat text, credentials, or host paths.

knox_id.description: Sorted account list; empty means all accounts.

team.description: Effective exact department filter; null means all.

provider.description: Effective exact provider filter; null means all.

model.description: Effective exact model filter; null means all.

next_offset.description: Next offset if more matches exist; otherwise null.
